visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene starts with a macro close-up of a human scalp with dark, coarse hair. A pair of hands parts the hair to reveal a inflamed, red acne-like bump on the skin. The lighting is bright and direct, emphasizing the texture of the scalp. (2) A woman with short, brown, bob-style hair, wearing rectangular glasses and a ribbed light pink turtleneck sweater, appears in a medium shot. She holds a small lavalier microphone near her mouth. The background is a tidy office with books and certificates. (3) A detailed 3D medical animation shows a cross-section of skin. Stylized purple epidermis and pink dermis layers are shown with yellow sebum glands and a central hair follicle. White spheres representing oil droplets are seen moving through the pore. (4) The woman is shown again in a medium shot, gesturing with her hands and pointing towards her own head to emphasize her point. She maintains direct eye contact with the camera, looking friendly and professional. (5) A montage of close-up images shows severe cases of scalp acne and folliculitis, featuring red pustules and inflamed hair follicles. White text labels describing types of bacteria appear as overlays on the images. (6) A person is seen from behind in a shower, washing their hair. Water streams down over dark hair and white soap suds are visible. The lighting is soft and slightly diffused by the water. (7) Back to the woman in the pink sweater, she holds up a bottle of blue anti-dandruff shampoo and a white bottle of medical-style shampoo. She demonstrates how to apply and leave the product on the scalp. (8) The video ends with a clean graphic background featuring the "DRX Series Skincare" logo in black and white minimalist design.
